title: MK Sandbox Journal
description: Imports and synchronizes structured MK-Sandbox campaign records from GitHub into organized Foundry journals with a dedicated browsing sheet.

mk-module-hub.summary: Imports and synchronizes structured MK-Sandbox campaign records from GitHub into organized Foundry journals with a dedicated browsing sheet.
features: Import from immutable GitHub repository snapshots
Organize records into dedicated Journal folders
Stable source IDs for safe synchronization
Preserve GM Notes and manually created pages
Custom journal sheet with navigation and source metadata
GM-only import button and macro API
